svg.title: WarHeatMap - live global conflict intelligence platform
svg.desc: WarHeatMap, a live global conflict intelligence platform, reachable at warheatmap.app and released under the MIT licence. The live status was measured by HTTP request at 2026-08-27 17:12 ET, not asserted. No stack, traffic, latency or event-count claims appear here: none of them could be independently verified, so this asset states only what was measured.
